tool.name: CompareNoiseMaps

param.name: baseline
param.dialogReference:
The LAeq raster of the reference situation (for example today), made by 'Noise Map'.
Required.

param.name: scenario
param.dialogReference:
The LAeq raster of the situation to compare (for example with a new barrier), made by 'Noise Map'.
Required. It must have the same area and cell size as the baseline: run both with the same calculation area and cell size.

param.name: out_gdb
param.dialogReference:
The file geodatabase where all results are written.
Required. Pre-filled with the default geodatabase of the project.

param.name: threshold
param.displayname: Report the area changed by at least (dB)
param.dialogReference:
Change in dB that counts as 'quieter' or 'louder'. The tool reports the share of the area quieter by at least this value and louder by at least this value.
Default: 3 dB.

param.name: run_name
param.dialogReference:
Start of the name of every output of this run (for example NoiseRun_LAeq). If the name already exists in the geodatabase a number is added, so nothing is overwritten.
Default: NoiseRun (Receivers / Compare in the other tools).

param.name: add_map
param.displayname: Add the result to the active map
param.dialogReference: Add the difference raster (scenario minus baseline) to the active map. Default: yes.

tool.summary: Subtracts a baseline LAeq raster from a scenario LAeq raster (same grid) and reports how much of the area became quieter or louder.

dataIdInfo.idAbs: Subtracts a baseline LAeq raster from a scenario LAeq raster (same grid) and reports how much of the area became quieter or louder.
